description: CFTC Commitments of Traders: one row per futures contract per weekly report_date. noncomm = large speculators, comm = hedgers, nonrept = small; *_net = long - short. Legacy report, futures and options combined; each row's source_url is that row's own query on it. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on report_date; these and contract_market_name filter a bounded window. Default: report_date desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_cftc_cot_reports
name: get_cftc_cot_reports
